title: Emperor Caligula is assassinated
summary: Officers of the Praetorian Guard led by Cassius Chaerea killed the emperor Caligula in a passage of the palace on the Palatine. The guard then proclaimed his uncle Claudius emperor.
reason: Caligula's cruelty, humiliation of senators and officers, and erratic rule had made many enemies at court.
significance: It showed that the Praetorian Guard could make and unmake emperors.
